item.title: Health and Human Services Department: Health and Human Services Acquisition Regulations; Correction
item.description: This document corrects technical and typographical errors in the final rule that appeared in the Federal Register on November 18, 2015, titled "Health and Human Services Acquisition Regulations."

item.title: Health and Human Services Department: HIPAA Privacy Rule: Changes To Support Coordinated Care and Individual Engagement and Reduce Regulatory Burdens
item.description: The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS or "Department") is issuing this final rule to modify the Standards for Privacy of Individually Identifiable Health Information ("Privacy Rule") under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) and the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (HITECH) Act. These modifications address standards that may impede the nationwide transition to value-based health care by limiting or discouraging…

item.title: Justice Department: Appellate Procedures for the Board of Immigration Appeals
item.description: In February 2026, the Department issued an interim final rule ("IFR"), effective March 9, 2026, to streamline Board of Immigration Appeals ("Board" or "BIA") procedures. The IFR's comment period closed on April 8, 2026. In this final rule, the Department responds to comments received and finalizes the IFR with minor changes.

item.title: Health and Human Services Department: Restoring Flexibility To Support Head Start Program Access
item.description: In this final rule, the Administration for Children and Families (ACF) removes requirements from the Head Start Program Performance Standards (Performance Standards) to restore local flexibility to Head Start programs and improve access to quality services. Specifically, this final rule removes requirements related to wages and benefits that the Administration believes are not in line with the plain language of the Head Start Act and are costly and overly prescriptive for Head Start programs…

item.title: Housing and Urban Development Department: Housing and Community Development Act of 1980: Verification of Eligible Status
item.description: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations to require the verification of U.S. citizenship or the eligible immigration status of all applicants and recipients of assistance under a covered program regardless of age. The rule will also make prorated assistance a temporary condition pending verification of eligible status of all family members, where permitted by statute, as opposed to under HUD's current regulations where prorated assistance could continue indefinitely. These…

item.title: Labor Department: Prohibiting Illegal Discrimination in Registered Apprenticeship Programs
item.description: The Department of Labor (DOL or the Department) is issuing this final rule to remove the onerous and legally questionable affirmative action requirements that were previously imposed by the Department on Registered Apprenticeship program sponsors. This final rule also streamlines and simplifies nondiscrimination obligations for all program sponsors, while clarifying that sponsors are accountable for compliance with Federal and State nondiscrimination protections. It also makes conforming…

item.title: Agriculture Department: Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC): Online Ordering and Transactions and Food Delivery Revisions To…

item.title: Health and Human Services Department: Medicare and Medicaid Programs; Organ Procurement Organizations Conditions for Coverage: Revisions to the Conditions for Coverage

item.title: Interior Department: Alaska; Wildlife, Harvest, and Access; Correction
item.description: The National Park Service (NPS) is correcting a final rule that appeared in the Federal Register on October 19, 2026. The rule amended regulations for hunting, fishing, trapping, and other harvest- related activities in Alaska and the procedures used to restrict public use and access in Alaska park areas, including for subsistence.

item.title: Health and Human Services Department: Health Data, Technology, and Interoperability: ONC Deregulatory Actions To Unleash Prosperity
item.description: This final rule focuses on deregulatory actions identified in HHS regulations regarding health information technology standards, implementation specifications, and certification criteria and regarding certification programs for health information technology. This final rule reduces burden, offers flexibility to both developers and providers, and supports innovation through the removal and revision of certain certification criteria and regulatory provisions.

item.title: Justice Department: Implementation of HAVANA Act of 2021

This final rule also streamlines and simplifies nondiscrimination obligations for all program sponsors, while clarifying that sponsors are accountable for compliance with Federal and State nondiscrimination protections. item.description: This final rule considers public comments submitted in response to the proposed rule to remove barriers to online ordering and internet-based transactions in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) published on February 23, 2023. item.title: Health and Human Services Department: Medicare and Medicaid Programs; Organ Procurement Organizations Conditions for Coverage: Revisions to the Conditions for Coverage
item.description: This final rule revises the Conditions for Coverage for Organ Procurement Organizations (OPOs) to clarify outstanding procedural questions and provide additional operational flexibility for OPOs to achieve high performance resulting in the successful procurement, distribution, and transplantation of more life-saving organs. item.description: The Department is issuing a final regulation that will require providers of pharmacy benefit management services and affiliated providers of brokerage and consulting services to disclose information about their compensation to fiduciaries of large, self-insured group health plans subject to the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA). item.title: Personnel Management Office: Personnel Management in Agencies: Strategic Human Capital Management
item.description: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is issuing a final rule to modernize the framework governing personnel management and strategic human capital management in Federal agencies. This rule amends the regulatory framework for personnel management in Federal agencies to streamline human capital planning and reporting requirements, strengthen the authority of agency Chief Human Capital Officers (CHCOs), update employee survey requirements, and align the regulatory framework with Executive…

item.title: Interior Department: Alaska; Wildlife, Harvest, and Access; Correction
item.description: The National Park Service (NPS) is correcting a final rule that appeared in the Federal Register on October 19, 2026. The rule amended regulations for hunting, fishing, trapping, and other harvest- related activities in Alaska and the procedures used to restrict public use and access in Alaska park areas, including for subsistence.

item.title: Health and Human Services Department: Health Data, Technology, and Interoperability: ONC Deregulatory Actions To Unleash Prosperity
item.description: This final rule focuses on deregulatory actions identified in HHS regulations regarding health information technology standards, implementation specifications, and certification criteria and regarding certification programs for health information technology. This final rule reduces burden, offers flexibility to both developers and providers, and supports innovation through the removal and revision of certain certification criteria and regulatory provisions.

item.title: Justice Department: Implementation of HAVANA Act of 2021
item.description: On April 19, 2024, the Department of Justice published an interim final rule to implement the HAVANA Act of 2021. No comments were received on the interim final rule. The HAVANA Act authorizes agency heads to provide payments to certain individuals who have incurred qualifying injuries to the brain. item.title: Housing and Urban Development Department: Housing and Community Development Act of 1980: Verification of Eligible Status
item.description: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations to require the verification of U.S. citizenship or the eligible immigration status of all applicants and recipients of assistance under a covered program regardless of age.
